product_metadata.title: Vtopmart Airtight Food Storage Containers With Lids, 4 PCS 2.8L Pasta Containers for Pantry Organization and Storage, BPA Free Kitchen Storage Containers for Spaghetti, Flour, Sugar and Noodles, Black
features: SUITABLE PANTRY ORGANIZATION AND STORAGE SET--- Our 4 pack air tight containers set comes with the same size, it includes 4 tall airtight food storage containers (2.8L / 2.46qt) and 24 labels. They will help you organize your pantry and kitchen neatly.

SEAL SECURELY ---These plastic canisters with durable lids are leak proof. 4 Safe side-locking lids with black silicone gasket make these kitchen pantry containers airtight. It ensures that no air or water enters in, keeping your snacks food fresh and dry and preventing liquid food from spilling.

SPACE-SAVING DESIGN---Our pasta containers for pantry are designed to save space, they make full use of space of your kitchen and pantry. They will easily fit into your cupboards, pantry, closet, shelves, freezer and refrigerator, which makes food storage more organized.

BPA FREE---The airtight food storage containers are made of high-quality food grade plastic materials, BPA free. These pantry storage containers are easy to clean and dishwasher safe, please hand wash the lids.

MULTI-PURPOSE FOR DIFFERENT FOOD STORAGE--- Our tall food storage containers for pantry are suitable for spaghetti containers. Ideal for storing kinds of pasta, spaghetti, noodles, dry food like oats, grain, rice, cereals, nuts, corn, chips, snacks, coffee, tea and beans. They are also ideal for storing kinds of baking supplies, such as flour and sugar.
